use_case: Demand forecasting for distribution and power transformers, used to plan plant capacity and to allocate storm-reserve production slots and spare units
business_owner: VP supply chain and demand planning
vendor_or_model: In-house time-series models on the group data platform (Cloud provider A)
data_categories: GEPS order history; customer forecasts; storm and weather history; utility capital plans (Confidential); no personal information
consequential_decision_category: Safety/CI (allocation of grid-restoration equipment to utilities, including the affiliated Electric Utility)
human_in_the_loop: Planners review every forecast; the storm allocation committee (VP supply chain, VP manufacturing operations, counsel) approves slot allocations under a written rule that the forecast cannot override
applicable_laws: No AI-specific law; customer supply agreements and the 2019 intercompany supply agreement (allocation terms); FTC Act Sec. 5 only if forecasts are described to customers; Group AI Standard (POL-01 4.12)
status: In production since 2024; conditions set (allocation rule, independent validation, change gate)

use_case: Predictive maintenance for drying ovens, vacuum oil processing, winding machines, and test lab equipment from plant historian data
vendor_or_model: Predictive maintenance SaaS vendor models trained on group historian data, run on the group data platform
data_categories: Plant historian sensor tags (Internal); maintenance records; no personal information
consequential_decision_category: None directly (maintenance planning). Re-tier to Safety/CI if used to defer or cancel scheduled maintenance
human_in_the_loop: Maintenance planners decide every work order; the model may add or advance maintenance but may never defer or cancel scheduled preventive maintenance; safety interlocks are independent of the model
applicable_laws: No AI-specific law; vendor contract (no-training and data-return terms); group OT security standard (SP 800-82 Rev. 3); Group AI Standard
status: In production at P1 to P7; P8 connector disabled 2026-09-30 until the OT DMZ replica exists (POAM-007)

use_case: Transformer asset-health analytics in the Fleet Monitoring Service (scores and alerts for utility subscribers)
vendor_or_model: In-house models in the FMS (Cloud provider B)
data_categories: Subscriber TMU data (dissolved gas, temperature, bushing, load) (Confidential); no personal information
consequential_decision_category: None directly; utilities make maintenance and replacement decisions on their own grid equipment. Re-tier to Safety/CI if subscribers automate actions on alerts
human_in_the_loop: Each utility's engineers review alerts against their own analysis before acting; the FMS has no control path to any TMU or utility system
applicable_laws: FTC Act Sec. 5 (accuracy claims in marketing); FMS subscription agreements; SOC 2 commitments (P09); Group AI Standard
status: In production (about 70 subscribers); method documentation and change gate due

use_case: Electric Utility load forecasting for day-ahead purchases and peak planning
business_owner: Electric Utility manager of load forecasting
vendor_or_model: In-house models on the group data platform (Cloud provider A)
data_categories: Meter interval data aggregated to substation level; weather; calendar (Internal); no customer-level data in the model
consequential_decision_category: None directly (operators and traders decide); not a BES Cyber System
human_in_the_loop: Load forecasting analysts review each forecast; system operations and power supply staff decide purchases and peak actions
applicable_laws: No AI-specific law; wholesale purchase contracts; Group AI Standard. Re-check CIP-002 categorization if the model is ever moved into the TCC or used for real-time operations

use_case: Group enterprise generative AI assistant (drafting, summarizing, searching approved internal content)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI service from a third-party model provider under group contract
data_categories: Internal and Confidential business documents; prohibited: BCSI, CEII, FCI, designs, and personal information of employees beyond the user's own
consequential_decision_category: None; prohibited for employment, credit, or other decisions about individuals
human_in_the_loop: Users review all output; outputs are drafts only
applicable_laws: FTC Act Sec. 5 (vendor claims); state AI employment laws if ever used in HR decisions (prohibited); POL-05 4.8

use_case: Generative AI design assistant for drafting specifications, design narratives, and calculation write-ups
vendor_or_model: Third-party model provider through the group enterprise contract
data_categories: Project documents (Confidential); client BCSI and CEII prohibited
consequential_decision_category: None as configured; prohibited for protection settings calculations, which would be Safety/CI
human_in_the_loop: A licensed engineer reviews every output before it enters a deliverable; the engineer of record seals deliverables
applicable_laws: Client confidentiality and CIP-011-3 flow-down terms (no BCSI or CEII in prompts); FTC Act Sec. 5; Group AI Standard
status: Pilot (120 engineers); conditions set before expansion

use_case: Computer vision inspection of welds and paint on tank lines at P4 and P5
vendor_or_model: Vision inspection system vendor models on edge devices in the OT network
data_categories: Images of tanks and welds (Internal); no personal information (cameras exclude work areas with people)
consequential_decision_category: None directly; final acceptance stays with quality inspectors and routine electrical tests
human_in_the_loop: Inspectors review every rejected and a sample of passed tanks; certified routine tests are unchanged
applicable_laws: No AI-specific law; customer quality specifications; group OT security standard
status: In production at P4; P5 pilot

use_case: Coding assistant for TMU firmware and configuration software developers
vendor_or_model: Generative coding service from a third-party model provider (enterprise terms; no training on group code)
data_categories: Firmware source code (Confidential); secrets and signing material prohibited
consequential_decision_category: None directly; affects the security of firmware deployed on the grid, so all output goes through code review and the signed build process
human_in_the_loop: Peer code review of every change; static analysis in the build pipeline; no generated code bypasses review
applicable_laws: Utility addenda secs. 4 and 5 (vulnerability disclosure; integrity of supplied firmware); Group AI Standard

use_case: Accounts payable invoice matching suggestions in the GEPS
human_in_the_loop: AP clerks approve every match; payment approvals unchanged
applicable_laws: No AI-specific law; internal control over financial reporting
